title: Implementace knihovny pro použití Domain-Driven Designu v prostředí .NET a Mongo DB
author: dužij maxim
title_eng: ddd infrastructure library on .net core platform using mongodb
abstract: ddd (domain-driven design) is a popular approach to complex software development. however, there are many ways to implement such approach on .net core platform using mongodb database.main goal of this bachelor thesis is a creation of a framework that could help me, as a developer, speed up early development and use ddd approach in my .net application. the framework will include not only common ddd objects and interfaces (typed identifiers, domain aggregates and domain events) but also include persistence layer where it will use mongodb database engine.part of this bachelor work will also include sample library domain and library client application (razor pages) what will use the framework and demonstrate basic principles of ddd.
key_words: ddd; domain-driven design; mongodb; .net core

title: Model-driven development a jeho využití při vývoji velkých informačních systémů
author: barchánková adéla
title_eng: model driven development and its use in the development of large information systems
abstract: the main aim of this bachelor thesis is to provide a comprehensive description of model-driven development and analyse its approaches, practices and available tools with focus on server-based applications of large information systems. the first part of this study shall cover the definitions of the methodology, its principles, best practices, and analyse the possible benefits or disadvantages of this approach. it will also capture the current situation on the market with commercial mdd tools. second part contains an analysis and description of the metasystem application: a non-commercial mdd tool developed by czech it company, which is used for modelling and development of large information systems. the thesis provides a comparison between the mentioned tool and one of the most commonly used application – sparks’s enterprise architect with one main question: would metasystem be commercially competitive on current market? in the latter part, the thesis focuses on an analysis and design of possible enhancements in the functionality of the tool.
key_words: model-driven development; modelling; software development; information technology

title: Návrh uživatelského rozhraní pro chytré brýle
author: poláček robert
title_eng: user interface concept for smart glasses
abstract: the goal of this thesis is to design a concept of the user interface for smart glasses for everyday personal use, that should help developers to make digital products for this platform.the theoretical part contains an analysis of manufacturers’ approaches to user interfaces inside smart glasses. the first section is a list of models, currently available in the market. the second section aims to collect important information, that helps to design the user interface concept (elements’ placement in user’s point of view, user experience evolution and user needs). the third section aims to summarize current visual design approaches in extended reality industry. the practical part is the concept of the user interface itself, based on the research from the theoretical part. the concept includes optimal ways to control smart glasses, their physical characteristics, user interface components, suggested apps list and visual design recommendations.
key_words: smart glasses; user interface; design

title: Serverless Computing: Benefits and challenges
author: drozdová zuzana
title_eng: serverless computing: benefits and challenges
abstract: serverless computing is a relatively new, and still evolving cloud category, which brings a new approach to the development and deployment of applications. the serverless fundamental model function as a service (faas) allows to execute small pieces of code, without dealing with a server. the purpose of this thesis is to explore this topic more deeply, and introduce architectural design patterns, which are suitable for the serverless approach. this cloud category has benefits, but as it is a new technology, it has also certain drawbacks. this thesis demonstrates these benefits and drawbacks on use cases, or a situation. the purpose of the practical part is to develop a prototype application, which applies the architectural patterns described in the thesis. in the thesis is also described a detailed implementation and then evaluation of the application. the result of this thesis are benefits and drawbacks of serverless computing, serverless architectural design patterns and a prototype application.
key_words: cloud computing; aws; serverless computing; function as a service

title: Obchodní hodnota a vliv principů UX a UI v internetovém obchodě
author: nekhymchuk valeriya
title_eng: the business value and influence of ux and ui principles in e-commerce
abstract: this bachelor thesis explores the importance of user experience and user interface principles to an e-commerce website and the value their application contributes to the business. the fields of user experience and user interface design were defined and various principles presented. furthermore, the topic of e-commerce was described with a particular focus on how an e-commerce website's business performance is measured. the reader can expect to be familiarized with the terminology of the topic. the goal is to evaluate the impact of user experience and user interface principles on an e-commerce website. it was achieved by surveying people with experience in online shopping and experts in the field of e-commerce. further insights on the topic were gathered by interviewing some of the expert participants. the results demonstrate that user experience and user interface principles are highly valued both by experts who design and optimize e-commerce websites, and the shoppers who use them. the e-commerce professionals who were interviewed also agreed that user experience and user interface design bring value to an e-commerce business, and recommended close collaboration between experts in design, sales and data analysis.
key_words: business value; ui; user interface; influence; e-commerce; user experience; ecom;  ux

title: Analyza využití Google Analytics v konkrétní firmě
author: badashkhanov vladimir
title_eng: analysis of google analytics usage in a particular business
abstract: the aim of this bachelor thesis is to reflect influence of usage of google analytics on a product lifecycle. based on a professional literature and data that was generously provided from a multinational company that desired to stay anonymous, this thesis describes digital marketing and one of the major products in this field – google analytics.  part of this document is focused on technology behind google analytics. another part is focused on analysis of usage of google analytics inside a company that was mentioned above and one of its products.first part of thesis acquaints user with terms digital marketing and google analytics and reflects their importance in modern age while at the same time describing technology behind google analytics software. consequently, reader will be introduced to general information about company that provided data for research purposes of this document. in the practical part will be conducted actual analysis based on gathered data and therefore reader will explore the actual influence of integrating google analytics inside the company’s product.as an outcome of this research, thesis reflects usage of google analytics inside a company and states whether it brings value or not.
key_words: google analytics; digital marketing; web analytics; software

title: Prehľad psychosociálnych a kognítivnych faktorov ktoré ovplyvňujú priebeh softvérových projektov.
author: kočiš roman
title_eng: a field review of cognitive and psychosocial factors influencing software development management
abstract: software development projects are prone to systematic failure as a cause of involved parties processing and sharing information in maladaptive ways that impedes progress of the project. two explanatory ways of information processing are presented. first is the confirmation bias, which describes a natural tendency of individuals to avoid information that is not the information they would like to be seeing. the other is the mum effect, which is the tendency of individuals to withhold information for various internal and external reasons. an observational case study is presented that describes a software project plagued by the issues that the two factors are responsible for in many cases. some tips for information technology managers are presented with the aim of helping to recognise and battle the consequences of the factors taking effect.
key_words: congitive bias; software project; information transmission; mum effect

title: Světlo jako prvek vizuálního vyprávění
author: ziakun kseniia
title_eng: light as an element in visual storytelling
abstract: lighting is an essential part of filmmaking. it is designed to evoke emotions in the audience, highlight the characters and enrich the plot. light is as important as acting and musical accompaniment. many beginner film enthusiasts ignore the light and think more about the quality of the camera and lenses. but in fact, even with the best and most modern cameras, the image will look dull and flat if the lighting was not given enough attention.the theoretical part contains the theory of light as a physical phenomenon: it summarizes the history of technical development of light and describes the fundamental technologies that exist today. this part is followed by a chapter that deals with light as a means of expression and discusses ways of using it to convey artistic value. the practical part analyzes two films differing in mood in terms of lighting. the function of light is described in the context of a scene: what light tells about the story, what atmosphere it creates and what mood it contributes. the conclusion of the practical part is that the study of the theory of light allows the film to open to the viewer on a completely new, deeper and richer level. allowing him to notice important details that communicate more about the film than was just told in the plot. thus, proving the initial idea about the inherent importance of light as an integral element of cinema language.
key_words: film; hmi; tungsten; led; exposure; film language; lighting

title: Possibilities of Amazon AWS and Google GCP cloud services in specific usecases
author: michálek ondřej
title_eng: possibilities of amazon aws and google gcp cloud services in specific usecases
abstract: cloud iaas providers that target enterprise and midmarket customers generally offer a high-quality service, with excellent availability, good performance, high security and good customer support. this group of providers contain amazon web services who pioneered the cloud iaas market in 2006 and also google cloud platform who entered the cloud iaas market in 2012.work aims to analyze and differentiate three services which these providers offer to customers:* virtual machines and their usage in server scaling (aws elastic compute cloud, gcp compute cloud)* storage used while file sharing (aws simple storage service, gcp storage)* access management of services and data (aws iam, gcp iam)all of these three chapters contain detailed introduction of the service, the concept it roofs and detailed comparison of steps needed to set-up such services. this is needed for analysing the differences and similarities of provided services and serves two purposes:* comparison of services provided by these provides * evaluation of why is aws more popular than gcp and if customers should choose either of them
key_words: amazon aws; simple storage; ec2; compute engine; scaling; iam; google cloud platform; s3; access management

title: Role režiséra v reklamní tvorbě a jeho možnosti kreativně ovlivnit výstup
author: sobolev igor
title_eng: the director's role in commercial films and his ability to creatively influence the final output
abstract: the principal theme of this bachelor thesis is getting into details of the director’s job in the commercial production process and reveal hidden parts that might not be obvious for people entering this field. it will cover not only the creative side of this profession, but also what goes behind the scene, which might prove to be much more important, than the ability to work on set.in the theoretic part i will briefly describe basic terminology and cover some of the historical changes that happened in the commercial and filmmaking industry over time. finally, based on detailed research, the practical part will answer to remaining questions, giving a full picture of a commercial director’s profession, and give advices for beginner directors who are planning to work or have an interest in commercial shooting.
key_words: advertising agency; director; advertising film; production company; filmmaking; commercial director

title: RecruBot: Návrh HR Chatbota
author: nová denisa
title_eng: recrubot: designing an hr chatbot
abstract: the aim of this bachelor thesis is to design a chatbot named recrubot that will inform potential candidates about the company’s job opportunities. this work includes well described finalized design of the chatbot, including its structure, functionalities and components. necessary components for chatbot construction are researched and consequently discussed. the resulting design is then evaluated based on predetermined requirements and based on conducted interview with university students of various fields of study.
key_words: conversation agent; artificial intelligence; chatbot; recrubot; design

title: Recommender system pro B2B data
author: zajda tomáš
title_eng: recommender system for b2b data
abstract: this bachelors thesis examines the topic of practical recommender systems. the document consists of both theoretical and practical parts.  the theoretical part starts by describing and defining the concept of a recommender system. then the history and development of these systems are briefly described. the main concepts and design approaches are introduced based on several publications about the topic. the strengths and weaknesses of each design approach are considered.  one of these approaches is chosen, specifically the content-based approach, with the help of the facts described in the theoretical part. the principles of this approach are used to design a practical recommender system that proposes potential customers to sales representatives in the b2b market. the input of this algorithm are real-world data from the czech market provided by a company with experience and expertise in this field.  the first result of the practical part of the thesis is an automated algorithm that recommends companies to sales representatives based on their historical behavior. the second result is a web interface created to configure and test the algorithm. the last part of the thesis evaluates the created solution and proposes future steps to further develop and improve it.
key_words: recommender system; content-based filtering; e-commerce

title: Podpora v reportovaní a registrace bosenských emigrantů pro Velvyslanectví Bosny a Hercegoviny v Praze
author: josipović ivona
title_eng: support in reporting and registration of bosnian emigrants for the embassy of bosnia and herzegovina in prague
abstract: the main goal of this bachelor's thesis, which focuses on analyzing the needs and problems of the embassy of bosnia and herzegovina in prague, is to create an application for adding and editing records and building a dynamic dashboard according to the established needs. the main goal is to create a sw application for emigrant registration and reporting. in the theoretical part, the author explains the basic concepts of data visualization, dashboards, and its creation principles. this section also includes an introductory chapter on the embassy of bosnia and herzegovina in prague. the practical part defines the needs and criteria for creating a system and dashboard, determined by an interview with the staff of the embassy of bosnia and herzegovina in prague. the main benefit and result of this part will be a functional application and dashboard, created with the recommended principles from the thesis's theoretical part. in the last part, user testing verifies the application and dashboard functionality and whether users can easily utilize them.
key_words: embassy; emigrants; dashboard; data

title: Vývoj systému na správu serviscníh požadavků s využitím Microsoft 365
author: houdek štěpán
title_eng: developing field service management system using microsoft 365
abstract: small and medium enterprises in czechia significantly lack behind in integration of digital technology compared to large enterprises. many of the small companies still rely on paper and pen or excel sheets to assign work, keep records of employees’ working hours and work-related information which is not only time-consuming but often leads to erroneous results. the aim of this bachelor thesis is to assess the feasibility of development and implementation of a field service management system by a non-developer accessible to small and medium enterprises.  the development of the system is formalized by using some practices of the agile modeling while information pertaining to the development is stored using the diary-driven development approach. the development is led by a single person using only tools available in the microsoft 365 package. after the development is finished, the system is implemented in a small enterprise. to test the hypothesis that a small enterprise will accept such system, an expectation confirmation theory is used to assess the satisfaction of the end consumer. the hypothesis is confirmed by excellent customer feedback.
key_words: power apps; power platform; bookings; field service management

title: Podpora veganství. Účinky filmové propagandy.
author: dontsova ekaterina
title_eng: promoting veganism. the effects of film propaganda
abstract: the topic of propaganda in cinematography has been explored by many because of the opportunity movies have to influence peoples’ opinions. particularly effective at this task are documentaries. vegan propaganda seems to be underrepresented in studies conducted to determine its influence. the theoretical part of the thesis defines propaganda tools according to the institute for propaganda analysis. moreover, in the fourth and fifth chapters, i look into the devices used to influence the audiences of nazi and soviet propaganda. after defining the most effective tools, in the practical part, i analyse propaganda traits in the recent successful film “seaspiracy”, which brings up the topic of sustainable fishing. moreover, i focus on the filmmaking techniques and expressive means of cinematography that helped to convey the message of the film. this part of the thesis continues with quantitative research, particularly survey research. its goal is to understand whether the audience of the film was able to recognise propaganda in the movie. the thesis offers empirical data, that show the level of the effectiveness of propaganda. the result of the research shows that out of 30 people who ate fish before watching the movie, 21 did consider changing their eating habits.
key_words: vegan propaganda; transfer; plain folks ; montage; false dilemma

title: Využití rozšířené reality s gamifikačními prvky pro marketing na sociálních sítích
author: sittová gabriela
title_eng: use of augmented reality with gamification elements for marketing on social networks
abstract: this bachelor thesis’ topic is assessing the current state of ar. it focuses on the historical development of this technology and its current use for marketing purposes on social networks. the thesis contains an analysis of the program for ar effects creation - spark ar by facebook, the process of creation of interactive ar effect with gamification elements that can be used in the commercial sphere, and a description of the implementation of the effect on social media and its evaluation.
key_words: augmented reality; spark ar; ar effects; social networks

title: Návrh elektronického volebního systému využívající technologii blockchain
author: tkačik vladislav
title_eng: design of an electronic election system using blockchain technology
abstract: this thesis deals with e-voting and designing an appropriate e-voting system based on blockchain technology for elections in the czech republic and its parliament election. this thesis consists of a research of e-voting systems and a practical part, which consists of designing the voting system itself. in the first part, the first goal is to provide information and knowledge upon which the practical part of this thesis is based on. the author will acquire this information by an in-depth analysis of electronic voting and by studying already realised e-voting systems as well as voting systems based on blockchain and also their design proposals. the second goal is to create a suitable design of a voting system based on blockchain by using knowledge acquired in the first part.
key_words: electronic elections; digital election system; blockchain; blockchain elections; elections; design of a blockchain election system

title: Samoobslužné BI řešení pro podporu řízení farmakovigilančních signálů
author: petrášová jaroslava
title_eng: self-service business intelligence solution to pharmacovigilance signal management
abstract: the main goal of this thesis is to analyse signal management processes within pharmaceutical industry companies and then to propose a self-service business intelligence solution which could be used to streamline the processes.  theoretical part of the thesis introduces the science of pharmacovigilance focusing on signal management processes and outlines the eu regulatory framework and legal requirements. practical part then contains the analysis of the processes and guidelines. based on the results of this analysis, proposes an ssbi solution. the main contribution of this thesis is development of an integrated and centralised tool for standardized tracking of information regarding adverse events caused by a medicine throughout their lifecycle. this tool with various dashboards enables the management to monitor compliance metrics, facilitate resource management and provide a visual overview for the companies as well as for the clients. implementation of this solution could lead to improvement of decision-making skills of its stakeholders, leading to a consistent process void of scattering to protect patients and public health.
key_words: self service business intelligence; ssbi; pharmacovigilance; power bi

title: Loosely Symmetric Neural Network Implementation
author: formánková lucie
title_eng: loosely symmetric neural network implementation
abstract: insufficient or imbalanced data are a common issue, e.g., in healthcare where the data is limited to protect personal data and privacy. this imbalance results in classifiers' poor performance as they usually prioritize the majority class during classification.  the artificial neural network requires a large amount of well-prepared balanced data. human beings, on the other hand, can extract new information even from a few. this thesis deals with the implementation of cognitive biases into neural networks, which should help the model imitate human learning. the loosely symmetric model designed by taniguchi et al. had been tested before by authors in the language r and achieved the best results from all tested models. during this thesis, the implementation was created in python as there is no other available.  the thesis contains a theoretical introduction to machine learning, the fit algorithm of the neural network, the loosely symmetric model description, including created variants, and the evaluation. during the evaluation of the spam classification, the new lsnn implementation managed to keep up with the model lsnb and even achieved better performance than the elsnb model, which performed best on the same dataset in previous research. however, the method of "enhancement" is not clearly explained in the original description. therefore, it is unknown whether this model is the correct implementation of the original design of the lsnn model. this implementation of the lsnn model proved its potential. however, the fit process could be further extended with the method of early stopping.
key_words: cognitive biases; imbalanced data; artificial neural network; spam

title: Využití volně dostupných projektů pro sestavení integrované chytré domácnosti
author: marhan michal
title_eng: use of open source projects to build an integrated smart home
abstract: the consumer market with smart home products is expanding. to create a smart home in the past was to use expensive proprietary solutions from smart home integrators. today, many smart home devices can be bought in ordinary stores with computer electronics. but this market is still in its infancy. there is no single unified protocol, which would be used across all those available devices. the goal defined by the author in this paper is to create a design of a smart home hub using open-source software, which can even today integrate devices across different protocols. paper is split into theoretical and practice part. it starts with an overview of the current state of the market, then explaining the chosen methodology of system design. the analysis phase looks into details of protocols used in smart home devices, their available open-source implementations, and other software needed to make the smart home hub work. based on the analysis the paper proceeds into the practical part when a proposal of the solution is devised, and every chosen component of the system is described. in the next phase, every step in the implementation process is documented. the final phase then tests the implementation against testing scenarios, which verifies readiness of the implementation and its ability to be moved into a production environment. the system successfully passes the test phase and is already used in one running instance. the result is a local smart home hub, which integrates devices across protocols and allows their control from one unified graphic interface.
key_words: containers; internet of things; interoperability; open source; integration; smart home

title: Předpověď výnosu pšenice pomocí regresního přístupu
author: kuzdas vojtěch
title_eng: wheat yield prediction using a regression approach
abstract: this bachelor thesis explores the applicability of linear and tree regression models in predicting the true yield of wheat crops in the south moravian and ústí nad labem regions in the czech republic. thesis pairs sentinel-2 satellite imagery with single-season post-harvest yield data into a 10x10m grid. yield data are split into percentile and manually filtered datasets. two vegetation indices, ndvi and evi, are extracted from satellite imagery and used as the primary independent variables in model training. some models use additional post-harvest variables as independent variables. simple and multiple linear regression and tree regression with bagging are done to predict the true yield. all models across all datasets are compared using standard r2 and mse statistics. models based on heavily filtered datasets achieve r2 values in the upper range of 0.92. models based on less filtered datasets achieve r2 values of 0.65. however, the industrial applicability of constructed models requires further discussion due to potential issues (e.g. overfitting). tree-based models showed better performance over linear regression models. although perceived promisingly, tree-bagging did not prove to be effective on the given data.
key_words: yield prediction; remote sensing; precision agriculture; linear regression; regression trees; bagging

title: Investiční rozhodování za podmínek nejistoty na základě internetových doporučení
author: šumníková alžběta
title_eng: investment decision making under uncertainty based on internet recommendations
abstract: the main objective of this bachelor thesis is to make investment portfolios based on recommendations from internet news servers. due to high inflation, there is a growing interest in investing even among less involved people, who often follow such suggestions. firstly, articles are analyzed, and investment instruments are selected. next, based on the methodology, a statistical overview of historical data is shown, and the simulated values of portfolio returns and risks are generated according to the relevant probability distribution, taking into account regular investment. the resulting parameters are used to optimize a portfolio. the portfolio is composed of disparate investment instruments, such as investment into water, gold, agricultural land, stocks of cez company, and stocks of a fond following the s&p 500 index. the results show that online articles provide a helpful overview but not appropriate recommendations. according to news portals and optimization, investing in agricultural land is the most advantageous.
key_words: internet news server;  ivestment decision making; markowitz model;  monte carlo simulation; portfolio optimalization

title: Modelování volatility směnných kurzů v Latinské Americe pomocí EGARCH s body zlomů
author: lagos cordova marcial javier
title_eng: modelling exchange rates volatility in latinamerica using egarch with points of change
abstract: this work aims to investigate whether major political events like corruption scandals, presidential impeachment processes or general elections could be associated to points of structural breaks in the volatility of exchange rates in latin america. those break points are endogenously determined using the iterated cumulated sums of squares (icss) algorithm proposed by inclan and tiao (1994).   since exchange rates are asset prices, finding the effect of shocks in the volatility persistence is important for building accurate asset pricing models. then, because it better captures asymmetric characteristics of volatility, the egarch(1,1) model introduced by nelson (1991) is used to evaluate whether persistence in volatility is reduced after accounting for those breakpoints.
key_words: iccs algorithm; egarch models; persistence in volatility

title: Návrh testovacích případů pro mobilní aplikaci Pilulka
author: zhiliaeva alesia
title_eng: test case design for the mobile application pilulka "pill"
abstract: the aim of this thesis is to design test cases for the mobile application pilulka - an online pharmacy solution. the thesis is divided into seven chapters. the first chapter deals with software requirements. the second chapter summarizes test analysis methods and the design of test cases. the third chapter details the use of test management tools and outlines one of them. the fourth chapter is dedicated to the presentation of the tested mobile application and the analysis of selected requirements. the fifth chapter focuses on test cases using specification-based techniques. the sixth chapter contains the design of test cases derived from the functional requirements listed in this work. the last chapter demonstrates the practical application of test cases inside of the test management tool.
key_words: test cases; software requirements; mobile application testing; mobile application

title: Sémiotická analýza filmu Parazit
author: mozharova anastasiia
title_eng: semiotic analysis of the film parasite
abstract: this bachelor thesis is focused on the semiotic analysis of the film parasite and aims to identify unique signs of the film that reflect south korean culture and inequality in society while simultaneously analyzing their role in the plot. the purpose of the work is to analyze the demonstration of different classes in society and to understand if the cultural signs of the film have an impact on the perception of the essence of the film - who is the parasite? the work is divided into two parts, a theoretical part, and a practical part. the theoretical part focuses on the basic semiotic theories and their further development in cinema, as well as explaining the main aspects that make up the film, such as structure and characters. in the practical part, there is an outline of south korean cinema, the analysis of bong joon-ho’s film culture, and the film parasite itself, more specifically the plot, the characters, and finally the signs themselves. the final part of the work answers the question of the director's originality and talks about the reason for his success, as well as the possible impact on the future of cinema.
key_words: film; sign; semiotic analysis; class; inequality

title: Schopnost postprodukce obrazu nahradit analogové fotoaparáty
author: tanuilov maksim
title_eng: the ability of image postproduction to replace analogue cameras
abstract: the popularity of the desire to achieve a “film look” has been rising for a couple of years. the goal of the thesis is to develop a workflow that helps to emulate this look by using raw files, a digital camera and dehancer plugin. the thesis describes the characteristics of film stocks and raw digital files that play a key role in the emulation process. to test the hy-pothesis that the post-production process could emulate the look of film stocks upon the condition of using specific software and workflow, an experiment has been conducted. se-ries of digital and filo photographs have been shot in the studio lighting conditions. to re-ceive objective results, two same lenses and the same lighting scheme have been used for pictures. the results showed that the developed workflow can emulate the film look, howev-er, it did have some disadvantages caused by software limitations. the main problems in-clude working with colors and shadows. for example, during editing in the color grading section, the midtones also affected the shadows of dark objects. therefore, the dark objects in the digital photo did not match the dark objects in the analog photo. this suggests that film look can be emulated. on the other hand, a universal preset cannot be developed to suit all the lighting conditions and compositions
key_words: emulation; film look; software; dehancer

title: Technická analýza obchodu s kryptoměnami
author: drobil jakub
title_eng: cryptocurrency trading - technical analysis
abstract: the subject of the bachelor’s thesis "cryptocurrency trading - technical analysis" is the analysis of the cryptocurrency space, how it is different to the traditional markets trading and exchange wise and what tools and indicators of technical analysis to use when trading it. the bachelor’s thesis focuses not only on all of that but also on creating trading strategies based on the tools of technical analysis, using manual and automatic backtesting.  the aim of the work is to acquaint the reader with the basics of blockchain and how it is maintained, the cryptocurrency space and a few cryptocurrencies, the wide differences between cryptocurrency and traditional markets and technical analysis and its application to develop a suitable and ideally profitable trading strategy using various indicators. the data for the analysis is obtained from available internet sources that provide price development of cryptocurrencie together with technical indicators. the obtained values are processed in either the ms excel program or tradingview strategy terminal, where the basic mathematical and logical functions are used. the data is then evaluated using the trading strategy and the optimal variant is found and back tested on new data to verify its profitability.
key_words: cryptocurrency; financial markets; bitcoin; technical analysis; trading; trading strategy; blockchain; backtesting

title: High-utility action rules mining
author: hrudková kateřina
title_eng: high-utility action rules mining
abstract: high utility action rules mining is a data mining task, that aims to generate such rules, that would provide the user with the information of which actions might be the most profitable. to the author’s best knowledge, no open-source solution for high utility action rules mining has not been proposed to date. the aim of this paper is to present reader with brief background of the key topics (frequent itemset mining, action rules mining, high utility itemset mining) related to the high utility action rules mining and actionrules package and to implement a practical solution in python, to the existing actionrules package framework, that would enable high utility action rules mining. the chapters on frequent itemset mining, action rules mining, high utility itemset mining and part of the last chapter on high action rules mining were processed by the method of narrative literature search. through the method of analysis, the workflow of actionrules package was observed and on the insights of the analysis the aimed high utility action rules mining solution has been implemented to the existing actionrules framework.
key_words: high utility action rules mining; action rules; high utility itemset mining; python

title: Implementation of artifical intelligence services in cloud call centre agent panel
author: kovářík adam
title_eng: implementation of artifical intelligence services in cloud call centre agent panel
abstract: most call centers currently require expensive hardware and office spaces to operate. also, agents who answer customers' questions must manually search for answers in files commonly scattered across multiple locations. this prolongs answering time which, resulting in longer calls and thus larger waiting queues. with new cloud technologies, it is possible to create a call centre hosted purely in cloud environment that can be used in production without the need for any specialized hardware. therefore agents can work remotely since they can answer calls via web browsers or even via microsoft teams.  our department has already created a proof of concept web application whose main purpose is to see if agents may receive real-time article recommendations, but it also supports call answering, real-time call transcription, and translation. this solution is working, but to provide article suggestions, it must use amazon kendra, which is too expensive to be used only for this purpose.  since then, amazon has released a new solution called amazon connect wisdom which is interconnected with amazon connect, and it can recommend faq articles during calls based on caller's questions. the goal of this thesis is to create proof of concept web application that has the same features as the application described earlier, but it must use amazon connect wisdom instead of amazon kendra. it should also compare amazon to other cloud providers and evaluate if amazon is the right provider.  the thesis has two parts. in the first part, nlp and its history are introduced. multiple nlp cloud providers are evaluated, and an ideal provider is recommended.  the second part focuses on building a web application for agents. firstly, the architecture of the overall solution is described. after that follow chapters regarding infrastructure set up, cloud services configuration. the next chapter describes back-end and front-end code. then review from cloud expert matthias schardt is noted and the thesis ends up with a conclusion if this poc has been successful and recommendations if the project shall continue above poc.
key_words: ai; amazon; cloud contact center

title: Budování agilního dashboardu pro měření týmové produktivity
author: loseeva iuliia
title_eng: building agile team productivity dashboard
abstract: the topic of this thesis is a jira atlassian as a project productivity tool, which aim is to formalize agile technology and adapt it to the precise company requirements. the jira allows users to create their projects and to track the progress in agile or kanban methodology. the work describes various tools, which could be use for this purpose and reason why the jira could be selected as a main one in the company. the purpose of this work was to create various charts using jira, which could show a team or department productivity and help to improve day-to-day work in the company. the whole process of dashboard creation was described in the practical part. there are arguments why dashboard should be created in jira. to detect which charts should be created the short survey among the team was provided. after the dashboard was created it was presented to the team and the feedback was collected of how they evaluate created dashboard and what benefits do they see. in the theoretical part the principle of the agile methodology is described. the analysis of the productivity tracking software market is provided, and jira tool is described in the details.
key_words: jira; agile; productivity; dashboard; scrum; kanban

title: Automatizované testování mobilních her
author: beliavskaia daria
title_eng: automated mobile game testing
abstract: the game industry has grown significantly in the last decade, particularly the mobile gaming segment, which now accounts for more than half of all applications available in the app stores. it is no surprise that there is a huge demand for higher-quality mobile game application. manual testing is still a common practise among mobile game developers, however today there is a range of test automation tools on the market, that can minimize the testing time and improve game quality and production time. the main goal of this bachelor thesis is to compare test automation tools for mobile games by evaluating and implementing them into the game prototype. each tool was evaluated according to the defined sets of criteria including test script development. based on the results, the most relevant testing tool was selected.
key_words: mobile games; game testing; test automation; object recognition

title: Aplikace komunikační inovace do jiného státu
author: onikova karolina
title_eng: applying a communication innovation to another country
abstract: this paper analyses the brand and communication of the russian company aviasales, targeting young people (generation z). the aim of the paper is to analyse elements of communication that can be successfully transferred to another market context and used to improve the marketing communication of a particular company - student agency.  first of all, the generations targeted by such communication elements are considered. next, the marketing and communication strategies, their components, and trends in modern communication, including brand authenticity, are described. this is followed by a description of the steps involved in creating a communication strategy. in the practical part, a study of a russian company is conducted on the basis of these data. next, the czech company is selected and the elements that can be used are identified.  the result of the work is a proposal, not an end result - nevertheless, it can be used to create long-term brand communication.
key_words: travel segment; communication; innovation

title: Ekonometrická analýza crowdfundingových kampaní
author: papush maria
title_eng: econometric analysis of crowdfunding campaigns
abstract: abstract crowdfunding is one of the most interesting and inspiring topics of recent times and is only getting more popular as time goes by. studying it allows you to better understand the incentive that arouse public interest, make assumptions about how information is transmitted and wonder as far is possible to predict the behavior of the crowd. not surprisingly, there are more and more studies exploring the subject. this paper provides a brief overview of articles on the topic of crowdfunding, mainly in terms of the factors that affect the success of the project. in the practical part of the current bachelor thesis, there is a study of the key success factors of the project based on the data of the two most famous reward-based crowdfunding platforms kickstarter and indiegogo. the practical part of this thesis is building lenear regression and logistic regression models using the datasets from the above mentioned platforms. mentioned models can predict the success of the project to a certain extent.
key_words: crowdfunding; lenear regression; logistic regression

title: Vlastnosti generalized autoregressive score modelů na konečných vzorcích
author: švrčina jan
title_eng: finite sample properties of generalized autoregressive score models
abstract: this thesis discusses the finite sample properties of generalized autoregressive score models (gas). it provides a theoretical background to the area of time-varying parameter models as well as a description of gas model and its properties. it shows the connection between gas models and previously developed time-varying parameter models such as garch, adc, and adi models. furthermore, it presents a simulation study of 29700 samples for the estimated gas models on simulated data, using the r package gasmodel, across various probability distributions and model parameters. the simulation study results then empirically show the consistency and precision increasing with the sample size of some of the presented gas models. the cases where the models have not converged are outlined, and a possible explanation is discussed.
key_words: generalized autoregressive score models; time varying parameter models; times series analysis; simulation study

title: Návrh firemní identity na příkladu kavárny
author: kozlova olesia
title_eng: developing brand identity blueprint for a café bar
abstract: this bachelor thesis deals with the creation of a corporate identity for the coffee place.the aim of this bachelor thesis is the creation of a functional brand design with a detailed description using the example of a particular specific company. the theoretical part describes what it takes to create a successful brand identity, how corporate design, culture and style are related and how this affects the product and the perception of the company. it also dedicates to outputting various types of logos, typography, and color palettes. at the beginning of the practical part, there is a thorough negotiation with the client to clearly define the goal and the expected results. thereafter, the selected company, its current corporate identity and last but not least its competitors are described and analyzed in detail. it continues with the application of the knowledge from the theoretical part using the example of creating a completely unique brand identity. in the end, it displays the results in the form of a brand presentation.
key_words: corporate identity; branding; graphic design ; logo

title: Implementation of Master Data Management Solution in a Trade Industry Company
author: pitko dariia
title_eng: implementation of master data management solution in a trade industry company
abstract: the primary focus of this work is the concept of implementation of master data management  solutions in developing companies. first part of this work contains background information provided that aims to familiarize with fundamental terminology associated with master data management and reference data management , as well as their interrelations. and it also highlights the importance and impact of mdm on business operations.the second part of this work includes an analysis of the current situation of the company and proposed steps for the implementation of mdm solution on the example of a particular company.   the main goal of this work is to determine the specific steps and processes necessary for the implementation of a mdm solution. the work can serve as a practical guide for determining the processes at each step of the implementation of mdm / rdm solutions for small companies that plan to grow and develop both in the international arena and in the domestic market, because for this it is necessary to effectively and efficiently develop data management within companies , as the amount of data grows together with the expansion of the company.  the work relies on information and publications provided by various articles, company’s internal documentation and  the experiences gained during the implementation of the project will also serve as valuable inputs.
key_words: master and reference data management; mdm tools; strategy of implementation; mdm/rdm requirements

title: UX Redesign aplikace Goodreads z pohledu vybraného uživatelského scénáře
author: holotova dariia
title_eng: ux redesign aplikace goodreads z pohledu vybraného uživatelského scénáře
abstract: this bachelor's thesis presents a ux redesign of the goodreads application (version 2022) for specific user scenarios, each representing different types of users and their specific needs and expectations from the goodreads app. the first scenario represents a user who is interested in tracking their reading progress, while the second scenario represents a user who is interested in organizing their physical book collection. the third scenario represents a user who is interested in discovering new books and authors through social media. the primary objective was to improve the user experience of the application and make it more user-friendly. the theoretical part of the thesis discusses the concepts of ux and ui design, their differences, and the design process, various applications that designers use in their work. furthermore, this work reviews the history of goodreads, its direct and indirect competition, and the challenges it faces. the practical part of the study followed a structured approach to design and refine the user experience of the goodreads app. it started with wireframing, selecting a grid, and preparing the components, colors, and fonts to be used. screens were then designed for each scenario, and proposed ux changes were made based on user feedback and basic ux principles. the resulting design was compared to the current goodreads app, and an interactive prototype was created to demonstrate how it would work in practice.  in addition to redesign of the goodreads application, this bachelor's thesis also includes user experience testing. a total of six users participated in the testing process, providing feedback on the proposed ux changes and suggesting additional improvements. the output of the work includes three user flows in figma, along with an interactive prototype. these prototypes serve as a visual representation of the new design, which can be used to gather feedback from potential users. overall, the thesis aimed to provide an analysis of the goodreads application and develop a user experience redesign that would improve the overall user experience.
key_words: social reading; reading application; usability; prototyping; user interface; user experience; user scenarios; redesign; mobile application

title: AUTONOMNÍ VOZIDLA A RISK MANAGEMENT KRITICKÝCH DOPRAVNÍCH SITUACÍ
author: oravský daniel
title_eng: autonomous vehicles and risk management for critical traffic situations
abstract: this thesis aims to describe, assess, and manage the risks for critical traffic situations associated with the deployment of autonomous vehicles (avs), touching on the application of insights from information and communication technology (ict) process and risk management. the study will explore the ethics of autonomous vehicles to evaluate the impact of traffic collision situations. furthermore, quantitative research will be conducted to investigate respondents' attitudes towards the risk of the described traffic situations associated with av deployment.
key_words: autonomous driving; artificial inteligence; critical traffic situations

title: Gacha systém ve free-to-play hrách
author: světlíková hana
title_eng: gacha system in free-to-play games
abstract: this bachelor thesis deals with gacha mechanism, compares three different gacha systems in free-to-play games, and takes a deeper look into the arknights gacha system whose simulation this work aims to create. thus the main aim of this thesis is to create a complex simulation in the programming language python and analyze its predictions and results. this thesis also describes the rules and common design practices used in games implementing this system and puts the simulation of one specific system into the context of other existing implementations, the history of gacha and similar random rewards mechanisms, and a probability theory. in the chapter dedicated to probability theory, this thesis explains related terms such as stochastic process, stochastic simulation, markov process, markov property, and markov chain monte carlo method, which is a method in a modified form used in the design and execution of the simulation. the results show how essential the implementation of pity is for the whole system. the results also state the prediction that the average resources needed to acquire the highest rarity reward are 48,000, meaning approximately four months' worth of standard game rewards or premium currency worth of 200\$. this thesis can be used both by the players who want to gain a better understanding of the gacha system, as well as the developers of games implementing the said system. it also puts current knowledge regarding legislation, regulations, and the psychological aspect of this phenomenon into a new perspective.
key_words: simulation; probability; prediction; game of chance; python

title: NFT a jejich možné použití v fyzickém světě
author: preobraženskij alexej
title_eng: nfts and their possible use in the physical world
abstract: in 2021, the sudden surge in popularity of non-fungible tokens, commonly referred to as  nfts, caused a revolution in the digital art industry and gained a widespread media  attention. however, this hype resulted in unrealistic expectations that proved  unsustainable, leading to a decline in interest and widespread perception that nfts were a dead-end. despite this, new applications continue to emerge, drawing in fresh audiences.  this thesis aims to explore unconventional perspectives and propose potential use cases  that demonstrate how non-fungible tokens can enhance our physical world and improve our  lives in the future.
key_words: nft; blockchain; cryptocurrency; use cases; non-fungible token; nft market

title: Videoherní skiny jako alternativní investiční instrument: případ Counter Strike: Global Offensive
author: půta pavel
title_eng: videogame skins as an alternative investment instrument: the case of counter strike: global offensive
abstract: this thesis deals with the game counter strike: global offensive in which there are collectable in-game items. the research consists of testing whether there is a relationship in the development of price of cs:go items, specifically the loot box operation breakout case and the redline field-tested skin on ak-47 weapon, and the development of price of more traditional investment instruments. the examined period is 2020, in which the investment instruments were more volatile. using the least square method, two regression analysis models are created from the data to further examine the price dependencies of the selected investment instruments. in the first model, in case of the operation breakout case, there is no indication of any relationship in the price development with other investment instruments. in the second model, in the examination of the ak-47 redline a dependency in price development with bitcoin is found. however, this does not refute the results of the first model in any way, but rather confirms the necessity of researching the potential of individual items and not as a whole. thus, the thesis shows the potential of cs:go items entering an investors riskier portfolio as an alternative investment instrument, as these collectables might have a unique development in price, but on the other hand, they are still not researched in detail.
key_words: investment instruments; market price; alternative investing; csgo; skins

title: Sociální média Instagram jako nástroj řízení vztahů se zákazníky
author: tomchanka maria
title_eng: instagram social media as a customer relationship management tool
abstract: this bachelor's thesis explores using instagram for businesses as a supportive tool for customer relationship management. the main objective of the bachelor thesis is to find out if instagram is a platform that can help companies to build and maintain relationships with their customers. the other aim is to describe the features of instagram and how they can be used for customer relationship management (crm) purposes. the bachelor thesis is divided into two parts: theoretical and practical. the theoretical part defines crm discusses crm systems and compares social crm to traditional crm. this part also discusses the importance of customer engagement and loyalty in social crm. besides that, it discusses different types of social media platforms and their benefits for businesses. the theoretical part is finished with an analysis of instagram's functionality and business usage. the practical part is an analysis of a questionnaire survey that examines the impact of business activities on instagram social media on customer behavior. ultimately, the thesis provides insights into how businesses can effectively use instagram as a platform for managing customer relations.
key_words: social crm; social media; instagram; crm

title: Architektura Datových Proudů
author: maksimenko ilia
title_eng: data streaming architecture
abstract: the proliferation of big data and the emergence of real-time applications have created a need for scalable and efficient data processing systems that can handle large volumes of data in real-time. the development of the internet of things is taking this to another level altogether; now data can come to us in real time, and our goal, in turn, will be to transfer it without loss, in the right order, and at the highest possible speed. in this thesis, author proposes a general data streaming architecture. the theoretical part focuses on outlining the fundamental ideas required to comprehend the topics addressed in the thesis. the primary part of this bachelor's thesis delves into the research surrounding data streaming architecture through a systematic literature review. the author begins by choosing relevant papers and subsequently analyzes them to emphasize the components of the proposed architecture present in each examined paper. using scientific methods, such as generalization and synthesis, the author identifies common components in the architectures reviewed. finally, based on the identified components, the author puts forth a proposal of a general data streaming architecture, with each component of the architecture being commented for a more in-depth overview.
key_words: data stream; stream processing; systematic literature review; data streaming architecture

title: Edge Computing: Architektura a aplikace
author: šlambor jakub
title_eng: edge computing: architecture and applications
abstract: this thesis examines the topic of edge computing. the aim of this thesis is to investigate the application of edge computing to different application domains such as iot, healthcare, etc., and to develop a prototype application that allows the comparison of edge computing solutions with the traditional approach. edge computing is first defined and categorized, the development and trends in the field are shown, and the hardware and software of a typical edge computer are described, as is the security of edge systems. a case study in a startup herohero is conducted, and an application prototype using cloudflare workers is deployed to production, fulfilling the aim and answering the questions of what the purpose and business case characteristics of using edge computing are and what are the benefits and drawbacks of utilizing the edge for the deployment of a web application. the methods of processing used to achieve the goal of the thesis include the analysis of scientific documents and internet sources, comparison of the traditional and edge approach, and gathering metrics to assess them both.
key_words: edge computing; cdn; serverless; web application; distributed systems

title: Ekonometrická analýza vztahu mezi vakcinací proti COVID-19 a výskytem nemoci
author: shaibaneev roman
title_eng: econometric analysis of the relationship between vaccination against covid-19 and its occurrence in population
abstract: over the whole covid-19 pandemic the efficiency of vaccination was doubted by a large group of people. it was even thought that they are more harmful for people who took them. in this bachelor thesis i try to investigate the relationship between given vaccine doses and two variables - the ratio of deaths and recovered from the decease and its death rate. i try to estimate this effects by developing an ardl model to deal with autocorrelation. i found a significantly negative total effect of the vaccines on the variables, whereas a more detailed analysis showed negative and significant effect on the variables from vaccine doses given in recent 3 months and also 9 months up until year. also, logarithmic transformation does not create drastic changes in estimates having a little better residuals.
key_words: covid-19; ardl model; autocorrelation; stationarity

title: Statistická analýza situací ve sportu
author: virba viliam
title_eng: statistical analysis of situations in sport
abstract: bachelor thesis offers insight into the specific sport situations from the statistic perspective that is possible due to availability of large amount well structured data that measure many aspects of the games. every situation is present in american football and data are exclu- sively sourced from national football league since 2000. american football as a sport is introduced followed by dataset description. after the league itself and dataset is described three hypotheses are formulated. first is trying to show how aggressive tactics could conse- quently lead to losing in tight games. second hypothesis looks at the frequent event that is taking a timeout before opposing team is trying to score an important points by kicking a field goal. last third hypothesis is trying to measure effect of stadium altitude on distance that is possible to be kicked by punter. hypotheses are evaluated by statistical hypotheses testing after data are processed in desirable condition
key_words: american football; sport statistics; nfl; hypothesis testing; sport analytics; data driven decision making

title: Vliv basketbalových statistik na výhru zápasu: Komparace české NBL, Euroligy a NBA
author: srp štěpán
title_eng: the impact of basketball statistics on winning a game: comparison of czech nbl, euroleague and nba
abstract: this thesis uses logistic regression to analyse which basic basketball statistics are important in determining the outcome of a game. the thesis compares six seasons of the czech national basketball league (nbl), euroleague, and the nba, both in the regular season and playoff, using only basic box score statistics or their derivatives. the created models were based on three different sets of predictors: the first set contained only offensive/defensive efficiency rating, the next set consisted of the so-called four factors, and the last one fitted ordinary statistics obtainable directly from box scores. the results suggest that efficient shooting, turnovers, and rebounding are among the most important factors to winning games in all leagues, with each league differing in which factors are more important. in the nba, there was a larger emphasis on efficient shooting, the 3-point shot was more important than in other leagues, with an apparent upward trend over time. the czech nbl and euroleague tend to be more strategically oriented, emphasizing turnovers and rebounds more than in the nba. additionally, the european leagues showed less difference between playoff and regular season, while in the nba, the difference in play style between the two was larger. in the nba playoff, the game becomes more similar to euroleague and czech basketball, with a greater emphasis on rebounding, steals, and turnovers.
key_words: comparasion; basketball; logistic regression; basketball statistics

title: Agricultural Production and Climate Change
author: kolomieiets sofiia
title_eng: agricultural production and climate change
abstract: modern civilisation faces a two-fold challenge regarding food security: ensuring sufficient food supply for the growing population and tackling hunger in the poorest parts of the world. on top of that, climate change is becoming more tangible and poses a potential threat to meeting food security targets in the future. these factors motivated the investigation of agricultural and climatic indicators in this thesis. specifically, the analysis was focused on the cases of two countries, the netherlands and tanzania, which were chosen as representatives of the two tails of the development ladder. the main goal of this thesis is to provide a picture of the past development of agricultural and climatic variables. the thesis can be divided into two parts. in the agricultural part, the focus is on agricultural output growth and the role of productivity. the method of agricultural growth decomposition developed by the usda is used, and the analysis is performed on the data set of international agricultural indicators published by the usda. in the second part, two climatic indicators are analysed: average temperatures and total precipitation. the data from era5 reanalysis is used for this purpose. descriptive techniques and methods for time series modelling are used to identify the extent of the changes that occurred over the studied period. the upwards shifts in the temperatures were found in both countries, while precipitation was found to have decreased in tanzania. the findings in this thesis provide the basis for further research on the relationships between agricultural and climatic variables.
key_words: agriculture; tfp; productivity; climate change; time series

title: Analýza volatility cen na trzích se zemním plynem a ropou
author: komarov vladimir
title_eng: analysis of price volatility in natural gas and crude oil markets
abstract: the present study aims to examine the return volatility of futures market prices for natural gas and crude oil during the time period of 2010-2023. it provides a comprehensive overview of the global natural gas and crude oil markets, as well as the european union markets, highlighting the factors that contribute to the high volatility observed in these markets, such as supply and demand issues, political instability, and governance influences. to achieve the objectives, three different types of garch models, namely classic garch, gjr-garch, and egarch models, are employed for analysis and prediction. the primary aim of employ- ing these models is to identify the best fit for the selected commodities using the maximum likelihood function and mse statistic. the analysis indicates that the crude oil market is best fitted with a egarch model, while the garch model is the best fit for the natural gas market. furthermore, the paper offers a brief introduction to risk management, and based on the best fitting models for each time series, the value at risk (var) statistic is calculated and estimated.
key_words: garch models; natural gas price; crude oil price; volatility prediction

title: Od statického k dynamickému oceňování: Potenciál využití Monte Carlo simulace v modelu Diskontovaných peněžních toků
author: burian matěj
title_eng: from static to dynamic valution: unlocking the potential of monte carlo simulations for discounted cash flow model
abstract: the thesis explores the use of monte carlo simulation to improve the reliability of the dcf method, which is commonly used in business valuation. the object of the valuation is skoda auto, the largest car manufacturer in the czech republic. the theoretical part of the thesis explains the fundamental concepts of valuation and underlines some limitations of the deterministic approach of the dcf methodology. monte carlo simulation is introduced as a tool to approach the variability of model parameters and as a potential tool for generating a range of possible outcomes. in the practical part, the classical dcf model of skoda is explained, and the monte carlo simulation is incorporated into the model using r, the statistical programming language. the simulation produces a sampling distribution of enterprise value probabilities, which, in turn, helps to identify the 95% confidence intervals of the final value. different scenarios assigned varying probabilities were also tested during the monte carlo simulation. the analysis of the results contains measures of central tendency, variability, and shape, as well as the kernel density estimate. in addition, these findings are further assessed through a finance sensitivity analysis, which aims to identify the most critical components of the entire model. specifically, the sensitivity analysis revealed that the ebitda margin is the most critical variable. in summary, the monte carlo simulation produced a range of enterprise value between 92 €mm and 487 €mm, with an average value of 297 €mm.
key_words: valuation; dcf; intrinsic value; cash flow; monte carlo; enterprise value; probability distribution

title: Development of a documentation generating application for .NET libraries
author: akopyan denis
title_eng: vývoj aplikace pro generování dokumentace .net knihoven
abstract: this thesis aims to research and develop a documentation-generating application for .net libraries. the main objective was to create a tool for .net developers that want to extract source code documentation and export it into their desired format while keeping the application extensible, cross-platform, and easy to use.  the theoretical part of the thesis shall cover the development planning and the expected result of the project.  the empirical part of the thesis illustrates the exact process of development. designing a decoupled project structure had the most attention dedicated to it.  the expected result of this thesis project is a working cross-platform and open-source application that can generate documentation from .net libraries and is extensible via plugins.
key_words: development; application; generating; documentation; libraries; .net; dotnet

title: Vývoj technických video návodů s využitím Triple Diamond modelu
author: manukian anna
title_eng: development of technical video tutorials using the triple diamond design process model
abstract: this bachelor’s thesis is focused on product development using the triple diamond design process model. the developed product is primarily aimed at vše students and describes the steps involved in accessing vše vpn and nas while also giving an overview of those technologies. the chosen media is a video with a voice-over.  the theoretical part is concentrated on human-centred design and its best practices, different frameworks and tools and particularly explores the double and triple diamond design process models. then a typology of educational video is discussed, followed by an explanation of cognitive overload, multimedia usage in video and accessibility. finally, the theoretical part covers informational technology essential for product development.  the practical part describes project development using the triple diamond design process model from the early stages which include research, problem definition and solution discovery to concept validation and development consisting of production and post-production.  the outcome of this project is a set of 10 accessible videos about the vše vpn and kme nas which proved to solve all the users’ problems discovered in this thesis. after watching the produced videos, users performed two times better on a test on the school vpn and nas. the needed services were accessed faster than expected and the videos were sufficient for solving the few errors which occurred during the testing. the user testing participants generally agreed or strongly agreed with positive statements about the videos and described them as informative, useful, understandable, concise, engaging, and visually appealing.  finally, advice on distribution and possible topics for other manuals is provided.
key_words: accessible video; hcd; vpn; triple diamond design process model; educational video

title: Návrh prototypu pro mobilní aplikaci Setkávač podle principů návrhu UI/UX
author: salnikova elina
title_eng: prototype design for the setkávač mobile application according to the ui/ux design principles
abstract: this work is devoted to designing a user-friendly mobile application ‘setkávač’ that plans  in-person meet-ups. the study's first section examines the fundamental ideas of ui/ux  design theory, placing special emphasis on user-centred design. the theoretical framework  offers a thorough guidance for design thinking process of this application.  based on the design principles of ux and ui, the prototype of the mobile application is  created during the practical stage of this work. the main aim was to design an interactive  prototype in figma program that meets the application’s purposes and user requirements. the whole documentation of the iterative design process, from conception to prototype,  offers insights into decision-making and problem-solving techniques. user testing and  feedback loops are essential components of development cycle that guarantee that the  prototype not only complies with design principles but also reflects end users' expectations  and preferences.
key_words: user experience ; user interface ; prototype

title: Velké jazykové modely jako nástroj pro extrakci rysů z textu
author: balek vojtěch
title_eng: large language models as a tool for generating high-level features for text documents
abstract: this bachelor thesis investigates the usability of large language models (llms) for feature generation from text, evaluating whether llms can produce interpretable and usable features for machine-learning tasks. the study uses two labeled datasets: the cord-19 corpus, consisting of coronavirus research articles with binary labels for high and low citation count, and a dataset of scientific articles from czech research institutions, with article scores assigned according to the m17+ methodology (ranging from 1 to 5).  seven categorical features were generated for each dataset using the llama2 language model. these features were used to train models for binary and ordinal classification tasks. performance was compared to baseline naive models and models trained on term frequency-inverse document frequency (tf-idf) and sentence embeddings.  in the cord-19 dataset, models using llm-generated features achieved an accuracy of 59.8%, outperforming the baseline dummy classifier (50.2%) but falling short of tf-idf (62.5%) and sentence embeddings (62.5%). combining llm-generated features with article abstract and title texts using the autogluon platform achieved the highest accuracy (66.5%), followed by combining tf-idf terms and llm-generated features (65.3%).  for the m17+ dataset, the model using llm-generated features attained an accuracy of 37%, surpassing the naive classifier (18%) and tf-idf (34.3%). sentence embeddings achieved the highest accuracy (40.8%), while the autogluon model trained on abstract and title text achieved 39.5%.  llm-generated features enhanced the predictive performance of models and demonstrated higher interpretability compared to traditional bibliometric features. however, a notable limitation is the computational cost; generating features for small datasets (2000-3000 samples) requires tens of hours on high-end hardware.
key_words: classification; feature importance; feature extraction; interpretability; large language models

title: Vliv ceny elektřiny na inflaci v ČR: Analýza ARDL
author: zhanbussinova zhanel
title_eng: the impact of electricity price on inflation in the czech republic: an ardl analysis
abstract: this research aims to find out whether or how electricity prices affect the consumer price index (cpi) in the czech republic. the impact can be significant because electricity has a certain weight in the cpi basket and the increase in its price is directly reflected in the higher cost of living. in addition, the transmission effect may lead to price increases in various electricity-dependent sectors, which will further increase cpi. in addition, rising electricity costs can affect production costs and consumer behaviour, which can lead to price adjustments and changes in the relative prices of goods and services within the cpi basket. this thesis adopts the autoregressive distributed lag (ardl) approach to cointegration originally formulated by pesaran (19) and later refined by pesaran, shin, and smith (20) with the bounds testing approach. while the final model shows progress in addressing autocorrelation and the overall significance, the impact of electricity prices on inflation remains unclear. further exploration using alternative specifications, additional variables, or data transformations could be necessary to strengthen the model and confirm the electricity price effect.
key_words: consumer price index; ardl; electricity prices

title: Využití metod strojového učení pro predikci výsledků fotbalových zápasů
author: fedorík martin
title_eng: utilization of machine learning methods for predicting the outcomes of football matches
abstract: this bachelor’s thesis investigates the use of machine learning to predict football match outcomes, aiming to achieve high predictive accuracy and compare it with bookmakers’ accuracy. a secondary goal was to evaluate the potential profitability of the models. we utilized a novel comprehensive dataset with detailed statistics, including expected goals (xg), to enhance predictive accuracy. the dataset covered seven english premier league (epl) seasons, with the 2023/2024 season as the test set. extensive feature engineering was conducted, resulting in 134 features, of which 52 were selected using recursive feature elimination with xgboost. hyperparameters for xgboost and random forest models were optimized through time-based cross-validation and random search. the models achieved an accuracy of 58.4% (random forest) and 58.6% (xgboost) on 370 matches from the 2023/2024 epl season, closely matching the bookmakers’ accuracy of 58.9%. a significant shortcoming was the models’ inability to predict draws, likely due to class imbalance and the use of accuracy as the evaluation metric for feature selection and hyperparameter tuning. theoretical profitability was assessed by betting a constant amount based on predictions, but it was not statistically significant at the 5% level. future research could incorporate player-level features, dive deeper into the problem of draw predictions and explore more sophisticated betting strategies to achieve statistically significant profits.
key_words: machine learning; football; match prediction; betting; sports

title: Analýza a návrh business intelligence řešení pro firmu DC 1 s. r. o. (Design club 1)
author: kalousek richard
title_eng: analysis and creation of a bi application for design club s. r. o
